title: Already-open event card still shows Register after the athlete is waitlisted
classification: Observed application failure; root cause requires developer confirmation
action: Update or invalidate the retained Event List data after entry creation. Verify the same athlete, event and entry when checking the card.

title: Other event cards still offer Register after the Single Event credit is used
classification: Observed application failure; root cause requires developer confirmation
action: Use the consumed-credit state consistently across all other event cards. Show Upgrade membership and route to upgrade rather than another entry form. This execution counted card actions; it did not establish that another entry could be completed.

title: Tour Manager payment stays Pending after the API reports Collected
classification: Observed application failure; root cause requires developer confirmation
action: Refresh the roster data when asynchronous payment collection completes. Verify the entry identity and update the payment cell when the collected state arrives.

title: Automation expects Confirmed although the card shows Selected / Ready to Compete
classification: Automation wording mismatch: the observed Selected / Ready to Compete state represents successful confirmation
action: Confirm that Selected / Ready to Compete is the correct label, then update the assertion and rerun it. Do not classify this observation as failed entry confirmation or mark it passed without a verified corrected assertion.
